name: Mara
title: Greyhaven Quartermaster
dialogue: Fresh supplies for honest coin. I carry only the basics; the finest goods still come from Greyhaven's adventurers.

name: Aldren
title: Greyhaven Vaultkeeper
dialogue: What you entrust to Greyhaven's vault will be waiting when you return.

name: Seraphine
title: Greyhaven Arcanist
dialogue: Power without discipline burns its bearer. Bring coin, and I will teach you to shape your first ember.
